Definition: Abiel, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Abiel is the father of Ner and the grandfather of Saul — 'a mighty man of power' whose son Kish fathered the first king. He is also the name of one of David's mighty men, Abiel the Arbathite, in the Chronicles list.
TheologicalSignificance: Abiel stands at the head of two lines: the family that gives Israel its first king, and a warrior who serves the king after God's own heart. I believe the contrast is the lesson — one line rises and falls with Saul, the other stands with David, and God chooses the house He will build.
